coverage_limits: No canonical build, full tools/check.sh, native CAD/source save, git action, GUI attempt, other-worktree edit or child agent. Only assigned new reports and ignored probes were written.

The full R10 suite supplied genuine all-severity/parity baseline and J2/TP CLI fault controls. No standalone all-track-errors DRC, ERC rerun, schematic CLI regeneration or full fab regeneration was executed by this lens.
